title: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Log
subtitle: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Log covers air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone. The facility maintenance coordinator records Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. HVAC Preventive Maintenance Log keeps Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance exceptions visible until the facility maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use HVAC Preventive Maintenance Log at equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone. Document air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone identity before Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance begins. Compare air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone findings with stated Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance issues to qualified HVAC service supervisor. For HVAC Preventive Maintenance Log, confirm requirements for Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance. Ask qualified HVAC service supervisor to review Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance conditions beyond the facility maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance, identify responsible parties, equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone, and the linked air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone source.

fields.label: Equipment tag, model, serial, and served area

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance facts for air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance tracked controls
items: Belt, bearing, fan, and motor condition
Supply and return temperature or airflow result
Coil, drain pan, trap, and condensate condition
Refrigerant-circuit visual condition and leak concern
Thermostat, sensor, alarm, and sequence response

sections.title: Status decision and next trigger
sections.guidance: Keep the Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Facility Maintenance Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Refrigerant or combustion concern outside authorization
Blocked drainage or active water damage
Required capacity, alarm, or sequence not restored
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance when energy isolation, refrigerant concern, combustion concern, or failed operating safeguard remains unresolved. Retain the available Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance proof and route unresolved air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone scope to facility maintenance coordinator.
